message.content: {"question": "Pure benzene freezes at 5.5°C and boils at 80.1°C. What is the boiling point of a solution containing cyclohexane dissolved in benzene if freezing point of this solution is 0.0°C? (For benzene, K_f = 5.12°C/m, K_b = 2.53°C/m, for cyclohexane, K_f = 20.0°C/m, K_b = 2.79°C/m)", "options": {"A": "82.8°C", "B": "91.2°C", "C": "80.9°C", "D": "83.1°C"}, "correct": "A"}
